summary: Hesai Group filed a Form 6-K on May 19, 2026, reporting its unaudited financial results for Q1 2026. The filing is a routine earnings release by the foreign private issuer, covering net revenues of RMB680.6M (up 30% YoY), lidar shipments of 471,723 units, and GAAP net income of RMB18.3M. The press release also discusses strategic updates like the Mercedes-Benz partnership, the Picasso SPAD-SoC chip, and Growth Strategic Initiatives, but these are forward-looking business developments, not a special situation event. There are no acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes triggered by this filing. As a routine quarterly earnings report with no special-situation catalyst, it falls outside the defined categories.
